title: Zephyr: board provision epoch handling
description: Board provision timestamp handling for Zephyr. AC: Optionally uses board provision time as floor if available.
notes: Verified against the stable shared firmware-build-floor work without adding edits. Existing lichen_epoch_floor_set_provision accepts only authenticated provision timestamps at/after the firmware build epoch and within max_lead_s; rejected/missing provision metadata leaves the firmware floor unchanged. epoch_floor_get/accepts consistently apply the authenticated provision floor when higher. Canonical tests cover missing, accepted, before-build, beyond-lead, and unauthenticated cases. Standalone AppleClang/UBSan build passed ctest 1/1.
close_reason: Board provision epoch floor handling already complete; deterministic canonical provision cases validated by standalone C test.
